metadata.title: MedOrbits FAQs
metadata.description: Frequently asked questions shown on the website. Answers are general guidance and do not replace official sources.

dataRules: id must be unique and use the faq- prefix.
category must be one of allowedValues.category.
sortOrder must be a positive integer; lower values display first.
relatedCourseIds and relatedExamIds, when set, must reference existing records.
Answers must not promise admission, employment, funding or any particular outcome.
Answers must not state specific dates, fees or eligibility rules; point to official sources instead.
The active field controls display only.

faqs.question: How do I choose a suitable course?
faqs.answer: Consider your interests, academic background, eligibility, costs and goals. Verify programme information with official institutions.

faqs.question: How do I verify a college or university?
faqs.answer: Check recognition, accreditation and programme details with the relevant official regulator or institution.

faqs.question: What should I check before studying abroad?
faqs.answer: Verify institution recognition, tuition, living costs, visa requirements, licensing rules and refund policies through official sources.

faqs.question: Are scholarships guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Eligibility, award amounts, deadlines and selection conditions depend on the scholarship provider.

faqs.question: Does the website guarantee jobs or admissions?
faqs.answer: No. Listings and guidance do not guarantee admission, employment, funding or any particular outcome.
